title: Verified dual-sourcing profit structure, optimal orders and reliability monotonicity
description:
Four complete Lean proofs for the actual two-supplier random-capacity expected-profit model: lattice submodularity in feasible orders; existence of a global maximizing nonnegative order with the necessary boundary-or-stationarity conclusion; the exact CDF derivative formula and its optimal-interior first-order consequence; and monotonicity of optimized expected profit in either supplier's reliability. All four full Prove2Me signatures are proved. Version 1.1.0 adds Equation (6) and Lemma 2(b) to the two-proof edition 1.0.0, preserving its proof bytes and archival history.

Demand is nonnegative with finite mean. Theorem 1 and Equation (6) additionally assume absolute continuity; Lemmas 1 and 2(b) allow atomic demand. The model retains independent atomless nonnegative capacity-loss laws, positive capacities, nonnegative revenue, penalty and costs, committed-cost fractions in [0,1], v<r+p and full CDF ordering in reliability. Equation (6) concerns a feasible strictly interior coordinate and distinct suppliers. Lemma 2(b) requires no differentiability of reliability-indexed laws. The conclusion is about the optimized value, not every fixed-order profit or an ordering of optimal quantities.

The proofs check measurability and integrability, integrate a pointwise lattice inequality, clip orders to a compact capacity box, differentiate under the integral outside null kink events, factor independent integrals into the exact CDF expression, and compare optimized values under stochastic order. No sufficient first-order condition, region-by-region optimizer classification or automatic downstream closure is claimed.

The original model and results are due to Yimin Wang, Wendell Gilland and Brian Tomlin, Mitigating Supply Risk: Dual Sourcing or Process Improvement?, Manufacturing & Service Operations Management 12(3), 489–510 (2010), DOI 10.1287/msom.1090.0279. The author-hosted published PDF was inspected and hashed. The appendix's Lemma 2 proof was consulted as browser-extracted text, but no immutable appendix PDF was obtained. The source paper is cited, not redistributed. mikedeng1 supplied the platform model, statements and qualifications; Shuze Chen reviewed the statements, not these proofs. Accepted earlier proof bodies are reused inline under declaration renames; this reuse is not counted as additional results.

The self-contained packet includes four unchanged accepted sources, independent full-type and axiom audits with autoImplicit=false, the sole platform definition, Lean 4.33.1 and immutable Mathlib pins, the established archive verifier, fresh reproduction logs and five rejected controls: changed proof bytes, an added local axiom, and weakened substitutes for Theorem 1 and both added targets. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound are proof axioms. Verified third-party compiled caches remain trusted inputs. The previous archival edition is preserved in the packet.

Alexander Richard Towell directed research, verification standards and publication; OpenAI Codex substantially developed, checked, submitted and documented the formalizations. Lean and Mathlib contributors retain foundational credit. Mathematical novelty, exhaustive priority assessment, source-author endorsement and independent human proof review are not claimed. Original platform submissions and acceptances occurred on October 21, 2026. This archival successor is a separate publication event and adds no new accepted target.
notes: Four accepted complete formalizations of established source results; substantive successor to version 1.0.0 in the same concept family. Source and platform contributors are credited as predecessors, not coauthors. A DOI is an archival citation, not evidence of novelty or peer review.
